question: With the accepted four-camera K/FOV, can the existing category-separated metric surface projection consumer retain the full visible collision-height target using causal native pose, including suspended objects?
hypothesis: Perfect per-pixel surface category and depth may remove contact-target coverage loss; native registration, sampling and overlap conflicts may still prevent admission.
novelty_scope: No new perception source admitted. Extends frozen v76 necessary consumer oracle to current full four-camera E0 and actual native camera matrices; not a new algorithm or the rejected source rerun.

Metric3D_inspected_not_admitted.finding: Demo inference receives RGB; de-canonicalization multiplies predicted depth by processed fx/1000. Learned six-channel recurrent update jointly changes depth/confidence/normals; no new measured metric reference or calibrated-ray geometry equation is established by this inspection. This does not claim model performance failure.

data_role: Already inspected development sequence only; not fresh holdout for this question.
target_domain: Exactly v95 full finite optical-Z .5–3m, dynamic CAD excluded, >.55m from true body, true collision-height .05<z<=1.5, all pixels, all four eyes. Suspended/unidentified retained. Truth labels offline only.
GT_class: 1 for original visible collision-height target pixels; 2 for true floor abs(z)<=.03; 0 otherwise. No reconstructed predicted-height semantic reclassification. No RGB semantic source admitted.

consumer.focal: Actual recorded optical focal_mm/18*640; every recorded camera optics checked
consumer.union: Union front and rear fused risk sets; no free or risk clearing
consumer.native_body: B=N@inverse(local), supplied to existing consumer; actual per-eye native camera matrices

controls: Same ideal source labels/depth rendered vs native pose. No perception model, threshold sweep, changes to sensor phase or current cameras.
stop: After whole sequence necessary gate, retain negative or qualified-consumer-only conclusion. No source model or actual navigation admitted by oracle alone.
